title: Pocketwire Rewards Training Note: The Clean-Record Anniversary Supplement
content:
The clean-record supplement adds points to a Pocketwire Rewards anniversary bonus according to how many clawback entries the points ledger carries over the last twelve months.

## Rule

The anniversary clean-record supplement is 500 points when no clawback entry is dated within the last twelve months, 250 points when exactly one is, and nothing when two or more are. The supplement is added to the anniversary bonus credited for the anniversary, in whole points.

A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Questions answered

What counts toward the record? Clawback entries on the member's Pocketwire Rewards points ledger, the entries that take points back after a merchant refund, dated within the last twelve months.

What is the supplement with no clawback entry in the window? 500 points.

What is it with exactly one? 250 points.

What is it with two or more? Nothing.

Does a clawback entry dated 20 March 2024 count on a handling date of 20 March 2025? No: the window starts after the same calendar day twelve months before, so 21 March 2024 is its first day.

## Count and supplement

| Clawback entries within the last twelve months | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 0 | 500 points |
| 1 | 250 points |
| 2 or more | nothing |
